description.value: Niche Wine Co. is a small-batch family winery and working farm perched 620 metres above the Okanagan Valley floor in West Kelowna, offering tastings at the Hilltop Bar & Patio and a rotating lineup of food pop-ups on Sundays. The property includes The Outside Inn, a collection of luxury vineyard cabins that make it one of the few true agritourism stays in the Okanagan — a compelling stop or overnight for cyclists riding the Westside Wine Trail. The winery is explicitly welcoming to 2SLGBTQIA+ guests and families, and prides itself on an inclusive, relaxed farm atmosphere.

address.value: 1895 Bartley Road, West Kelowna, BC, V1Z 2M6
